title: The Returned Transfer Fee Still Owed on a Keyturn Host Payout Account
content:
The returned transfer fee still owed on a Keyturn Host Payout Account turns on how often the account's transfers have come back.

| Transfers come back unpaid in the twelve months up to that day | Fee owed |
|---|---|
| Exactly 1 | 20.00 USD |
| 2 or more | 40.00 USD |
| None | 0.00 USD |

The fee is a flat sum rather than a share, and it is taken off the drawable sum itself.

## Points of judgement

**An account with no return in that period.** The third row governs and no fee is owed.

**An account with one return in that period.** The first row governs and 20.00 USD is owed, whatever the sum of the transfer that came back.

**An account with three returns in that period.** The second row governs, as it does at two returns and at any greater number, and 40.00 USD is owed.

**A return older than that period.** It falls outside the count, which runs on the returns booked to the account in the twelve months up to that day.

## On hypothetical figures

Where the payable balance is 4000.00 USD and nothing else is taken off it, the sum left after the return fee is 4000.00 USD with no return in the period, 3980.00 USD with exactly one, and 3960.00 USD with two or more.
